title: SentencesModeConfig
description: Schema contract for the SentencesModeConfig frozen dataclass governing multi-sentence processing mode parameters.

enabled.description: Whether multi-sentence processing mode is active.

min_sentences.description: Minimum number of sentences required to activate multi-sentence alignment mode.

alignment_method.description: Algorithm used to align source and target sentence sequences. Supported: 'auto', 'proportional', 'sequential', 'newline_join', 'proportion'.

spawn_order.description: Order in which spawned sentence-level processing tasks are dispatched.

parent_mode.description: How the parent sentence context is represented in multi-sentence output.

multi_mode_decompose.description: Whether multi-mode processing decomposes each sentence independently before combining results.

legacy_spawn_children.description: Whether to forcibly spawn child windows in multi-mode even when sentences_mode is disabled.

deduplication_scope.description: Scope at which deduplication is applied: 'sentence' (per-sentence local), 'global' (cross-sentence combined), or 'none'.

web_tab_mode.description: Delivery format for web browser mode: 'container' (in-page tabs in single browser tab) or 'tabs' (multi-browser-tab cascade).
